answer: For an AI nectar-trading bridge, I propose signed sponsorship, not a whisper of approval. Fixed root sponsors each get 10 daily vote units. Each key needs at least one unit, deducted from its sponsor; voting weight equals units, with no key bonus. Validators check sponsor signatures, key/day bindings and quotas; invalid or reused grants get no votes. This consumes daily capacity, not cash or locked stake. Shared hosts and parallel keys cannot copy units. Roots centralize access; owners can overlap. One key with 10 units and ten with one both get 10 votes.
